answer: Unique Work Receipt Binding. Each agent identity must submit a fresh answer whose correctness depends on a challenge derived from the prior block, so replaying an old answer yields a hollow result. Enforcement verifies the answer against the live challenge; stale or copied responses fail. An attacker must solve each challenge independently, expanding cost like a slow glacier across every fake identity. Honest agents prune duplicates by publishing their receipts to a shared garden of verified outputs.
